DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道でスマートフォンを拾いました。今、着信が鳴っていますが、出たほうがよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾得スマートフォンの着信へ応答すべきか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found a smartphone on the street. It is ringing now. Should I answer it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you should answer an incoming call on a smartphone you found. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の電話ではなく拾得品ですね。まず拾った場所と時刻を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So this is a found item, rather than your own phone. First, could you tell me where and when you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の近くの歩道で、十分ほど前です。私の物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 私物ではなく十分前に駅近く歩道で拾ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: On the sidewalk near the station, about ten minutes ago. It is not mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is not yours and that you found it on the sidewalk near the station ten minutes ago. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご自身でロックを解除したり、持ち主として答えたりはせず、担当へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Please show it to the staff member in charge without trying to unlock it yourself or answering as though you were the owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 画面に名前らしい表示がありますが、本名かどうかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 画面の名前らしい表示が本名かは不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is something that looks like a name on the screen, but I do not know whether it is the person's real name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether the name-like text on the screen is a real name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 表示は表示として確認します。持ち主をその名前だけで決めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will treat that simply as what the screen displays. We will not identify the owner by that name alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 連絡先を探すために中を開くこともせず、鳴った状態で渡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 連絡先を探すロック解除をせず鳴る状態で渡すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will hand it over while it is ringing, without opening it to look for contacts.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will hand it over while it is ringing, without unlocking it to search for contacts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。画面と着信の状況も含め、担当が確認します。ほかに触った操作はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. The staff member in charge will check the screen and the incoming call as well. Have you operated it in any other way?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 操作していません。拾って持ってきただけです。着信への対応もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 操作はせず持参のみと報告し着信対応を担当へ依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have not operated it. I only picked it up and brought it here. Please handle the incoming call as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you have not operated the phone and have only brought it in, and ask the staff member in charge to handle the call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。こちらでお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. We will take it from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 不在票の日付が昨日になっています。昨日受け取る予約をした覚えがないのですが、もう遅いでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不在票の昨日の日付を受取予約日と思い期限切れか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The date on this missed-delivery notice is yesterday. I do not remember making an appointment to receive it yesterday. Is it too late now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether it is too late, having mistaken yesterday's date on the missed-delivery notice for a scheduled collection date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その日付は配達に伺った日です。お客様が受取予約をした日ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the date we attempted delivery. It is not a date on which you scheduled receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 配達の日だったのですね。今日受け取れないと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 実際の配達日と理解し今日は受取不可と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it was the delivery date. I thought I could not receive it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you now understand it was the actual delivery date and had thought you could not receive it today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 保管期限は別の欄です。まず票全体を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The storage deadline is in a separate field. First, please show me the whole notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらです。保管期限はまだ先ですが、今は荷物を持って帰れるのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 保管期限が先だと読み窓口で今受取できるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here it is. The storage deadline is still some time away, but can I take the parcel home now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read that the storage deadline is still ahead and ask whether you can collect the parcel at the counter now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物の所在と、窓口で受け取るための確認事項を担当が確認します。票だけで即時受取を決めないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member in charge will check where the parcel is and what needs to be confirmed for counter collection. Please do not assume that the notice alone guarantees immediate collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 昨日の日付を消さず、このまま担当へ見せます。受取方法を今日相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 配達日を消さず票をそのまま提示し今日受取相談を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the notice to the staff member as it is, without erasing yesterday's date. I would like to discuss how to receive the parcel today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will present the notice unchanged without erasing the delivery date and would like to discuss collection today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。再配達の希望がある場合も、別に申し込む方法を案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. If you would prefer redelivery, we will also explain how to request that separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 配達日と期限を分けて読み、荷物の所在を確認して受取方法を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 配達日と期限を区別し所在確認後に受取方法を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will distinguish between the delivery date and the deadline, check where the parcel is, and then choose how to receive it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will distinguish the delivery date from the deadline and decide how to receive the parcel after confirming its location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。担当窓口はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. The counter you need is over here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給与が入った額を会社へ伝えたいです。残高の数字を入金額として書いてよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与入金額として残高を会社へ報告してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to tell my company how much salary was deposited. Can I write the balance as the deposit amount?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may report the account balance to your company as the amount of salary deposited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 残高には、以前から口座にあった金額も含まれます。入金の一件を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The balance also includes money that was already in your account. Let us check the individual deposit transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 残高全部が今回の給与だと思っていました。取引一覧を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 残高全体を今回給与と思っていたと説明し取引一覧を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the entire balance was this month's salary. I would like to see the transaction list.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the whole balance was the current salary payment and ask to see the transaction list. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの練習用明細では、日付と摘要、入金額が一行になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: On this sample statement for practice, the date, description, and deposit amount appear together on one line.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 会社名がある行はここですね。他の日の返金とは分けて読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社名の入金行を示し別日の返金と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: This is the line with the company name, right? I will read it separately from the refund on another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out the deposit line with the company name and distinguish it from a refund on a different day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。その行の入金額と、口座全体の残高は異なる情報です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. The deposit amount on that line and the overall account balance are different pieces of information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社から受け取った支給明細とも比べたいです。違いがあれば会社へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 支給明細と比較し差があれば会社へ確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would also like to compare it with the payslip I received from my company. If there is a difference, I will ask the company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you would like to compare it with your payslip and check with your company if there is a difference. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのように照合できます。銀行の取引記録だけで給与計算の内訳は判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can cross-check them that way. A bank transaction record alone does not tell us the breakdown of the salary calculation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 給与の該当行だけ控え、残高を書かず支給明細と比べて会社へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 給与行の入金額を控え残高と混ぜず明細比較後に会社へ聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note only the relevant salary transaction, compare it with the payslip without writing down the balance, and check with my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will note the deposit amount on the salary line, keep it separate from the balance, compare it with your payslip, and then ask your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記録は安全にお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep your records safe as you take them home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この二つの袋は別々に買えますか。一つだけ欲しいので、帯を外してもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二袋セットの帯を外して一袋だけ購入できるか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Can these two bags be bought separately? I only want one. May I remove the band?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can remove the band from a two-bag set and buy just one bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その商品は二袋で一セットです。帯は外さず、そのままにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: That product is sold as a set of two bags. Please leave the band on and keep it as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一袋ずつ同じ値段で売ると思っていました。まだ帯は外していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別売同価格と思ったが帯は未解除と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought each bag was sold separately at the same price. I have not removed the band yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the bags were sold separately at the same price but have not removed the band. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認してくださってありがとうございます。単品は別の棚にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Thank you for checking. Individual bags are on another shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一人分なので単品を選びたいです。同じ中身の物を見せてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一人分なので同内容の単品を見せてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is just for one person, so I would like an individual bag. Could you show me one with the same contents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to see an individual bag with the same contents because you only need enough for one person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらが単品です。セットと比べると袋の容量も違うため、表示を読んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here is the individual bag. Its quantity is different from the bags in the set too, so please read the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 単品のほうは小さい袋なのですね。今晩使うにはこの量で十分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 単品は小容量だと読み今晩分に十分と判断を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the individual one is a smaller bag. This amount is enough for tonight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Read that the individual bag contains less and say that you think it is enough for tonight. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ではこちらをお選びください。セットは元の形で棚へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Then please choose this one. I will return the set to the shelf in its original form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: セットはばらさず、小さい単品を一つだけ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: セットをばらさず小さい単品一つを購入すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave the set intact and buy just one small individual bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to buy one small individual bag without splitting up the set. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please go to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この時計の前で待っていますが、同じ時刻のままです。まだ約束の時間になっていないのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 園内時計が同じ時刻なのでまだ待合せ前か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am waiting in front of this clock, but it still shows the same time. Is it not time for my appointment yet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether it is still before your meeting time because the clock in the park has not moved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用時計には、調整中で停止しているという掲示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a notice saying that this clock used for learning is stopped while it is being adjusted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 掲示を見ていませんでした。時計だけ見て、時間に余裕があると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 停止掲示未確認で時計だけ見て余裕があると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I did not notice the sign. I only looked at the clock and thought I still had plenty of time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you had not checked the notice that the clock was stopped and thought you had time based on the clock alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在の時刻は、ご自身の時計などで確認してください。約束の時刻とは別に考えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the current time on your own watch or another device. Keep that separate from the time you arranged to meet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の電話では約束の時刻を過ぎています。連れが別の所で待っているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話時刻では約束後で同行者が別所で待つ可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: According to my phone, the meeting time has already passed. My companion may be waiting somewhere else.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your phone shows it is past the meeting time and that your companion may be waiting elsewhere. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それでしたら、いまいる場所と時刻を連絡するとよいですね。歩きながらは操作しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: In that case, it would be good to tell them where you are and what time it is. Please do not use your phone while walking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この時計前にいることと、時計が止まっていたので気づくのが遅れたことを伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 時計前の現在地と停止時計で気づくのが遅れた経緯を連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will tell them I am in front of this clock and was late to notice because the clock had stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your companion you are in front of the clock and explain that the stopped clock delayed your realization. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。待合せ場所を変える場合は、お互い同じ案内を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you change the meeting place, please make sure you are both referring to the same directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここで足を止めて連絡し、連れの返事を聞いてから移動します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 立ち止まって連絡し返信確認後に移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will stop here to contact them and wait for their reply before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will stop walking to contact your companion and move only after checking their reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。安全に合流できるようお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Take care so that you can meet up safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二人分の切符を買いたいです。行きは一緒ですが、帰りは別々になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 行きは同行し帰りは別行動する二人分の切符を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to buy tickets for two people. We are traveling together on the way there, but separately on the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about tickets for two people who will travel together outbound but separately on the return journey. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 帰りは同じ駅から乗る予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will you be boarding at the same station on the way back?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私は仙台から、連れは別の駅から帰ります。二人とも多賀城までです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人は仙台発で同行者は別駅発だが二人とも多賀城へ帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will return from Sendai, and my companion will return from another station. We are both going back to Tagajo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you will depart from Sendai and your companion from a different station, but both will return to Tagajo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、それぞれの出発駅と帰る日を分けて相談しましょう。券も各自で持つ必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us discuss each person's departure station and return date separately. You will each need to carry your own ticket too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚に二人分がまとまると思っていました。別れてから私が全部持たないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一枚に人数分がまとまると思ったと説明し別れる前に券を分配すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I thought one ticket would cover both people. I will make sure I do not keep all the tickets after we split up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought one ticket covered everyone and say that you will distribute the tickets before splitting up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 購入する方法と券の出方を窓口で確認します。まず行きの目的地を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will check at the counter how to buy the tickets and how they are issued. First, please tell me your outbound destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 行きは仙台まで二人です。今日中に帰りますが、同じ帰路を二人分は買いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 仙台まで二人で当日日帰りだが同じ帰路二人分は不要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both of us are going to Sendai. We will return today, but we do not need two tickets for the same return route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that two people are going to Sendai and returning the same day, but do not need two tickets for the same return route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 行きは二人とも仙台、帰りは別駅からですね。その条件を担当へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Both of you are going to Sendai, and you will return from different stations. I will explain those conditions to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 行きと各自の帰りを分けて相談し、別行動の前に自分の券を各自で持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 行きと各自帰路を分けて相談し各自の券を持つと復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: We will discuss the outbound trip and each person's return separately, and each carry our own tickets before going our separate ways.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Repeat that you will discuss the outbound journey and individual return routes separately and each carry your own tickets. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの窓口へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come to this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなお手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What kind of help do you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このアンケートを私と同居人が別々に書きました。一世帯一通とありますが、二通出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人と同居人が一世帯アンケートを二通作ったと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: My housemate and I filled out this survey separately. It says one response per household. Can we submit two?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you and your housemate have each completed a survey that allows one response per household. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この用紙の案内は世帯ごとに一通です。どちらかをもう提出しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The instructions on this form say one response per household. Has either of you submitted one yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ二人とも出していません。私が同居人の分も預かっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 双方未提出で同居人の用紙も預かっていると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Neither of us has submitted one yet. I am holding my housemate's form as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that neither form has been submitted and you are also holding your housemate's form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それなら二通を提出せず、お二人で回答を確認できます。内容は同じでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then rather than submitting both, you can check your answers together. Are the contents the same?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 利用したい時間帯が違います。相手の希望を消して自分の回答だけ出すつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 希望時間が異なり相手の意見を無断削除しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: We prefer different time slots. I do not intend to erase the other person's preference and submit only my own answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your preferred times differ and that you will not delete the other person's opinion without permission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 選べる数や自由記入の欄を確認しましょう。意見が違うことも、書き方を担当へ相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check how many options you can select and whether there is a comments field. You can also ask the staff member in charge how to write that your opinions differ.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自由記入欄があります。同居人と相談して、二人の希望時間をそこへ書けるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自由欄へ両者の希望を書けるか担当へ確認したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a comments field. I would like to discuss it with my housemate and ask whether we can write both our preferred times there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check with the staff member in charge whether you may write both people's preferred times in the comments field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その欄の取扱いを担当へ確認します。提出前に、どの一通を出すかも決めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the staff member in charge how that field may be used. Before submitting, please also decide which one form you will hand in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は二通とも持ち帰り、同居人と内容を確かめてから一通だけ提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二通を持帰り本人同士で確認して一通提出すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will take both forms home, check the contents with my housemate, and then submit just one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will take both forms home, check them together, and submit one response. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入で迷う点は担当へお尋ねください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please ask the staff member in charge about anything you are unsure how to fill in. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 声を出すのがつらいので、書いて用件を伝えてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発声がつらいため受付用件を筆記で伝える許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It hurts to speak. May I write down what I need to tell you instead?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to explain your reason for visiting reception in writing because speaking is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。紙に書いていただけます。受付で確認したい用件はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, you can write it on paper. Is there something you would like to check at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 初めての受診です。いつから声が出しにくいかも、この紙へ書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 初診で症状開始時期も紙に記したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is my first consultation here. I have also written on this paper when I started having difficulty speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that this is your first visit and that you have written down when your symptoms began. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 拝見します。症状の判断は診療担当へおつなぎします。受付の質問にも書いて答えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me take a look. I will pass the assessment of your symptoms on to the clinical staff. Would you also like to answer the reception questions in writing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。質問を一つずつ書いてもらうと、自分で答えやすいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付質問を一つずつ書いてもらい自分も書いて答えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If you write down one question at a time, it will be easier for me to answer myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for reception questions to be written one at a time so that you can also answer in writing yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では短い質問を順に書きます。答えにくい所は、そのままお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then I will write short questions one by one. Please let me know if anything is difficult to answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前と連絡先は書けます。聞き取れなかった質問には、もう一度書いてほしいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 氏名連絡先は書けるが未理解の質問は再筆記を頼むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can write my name and contact details. If I do not catch a question, I will ask you to write it again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you can write your name and contact details but will ask for any question you do not understand to be written again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: わかりました。この用件メモを診療担当にも見せたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Would you like the clinical staff to see this note about your reason for visiting too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。声が出しにくく筆談を希望すると、このメモと一緒に伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 診療担当へ発声困難と筆談希望をメモとともに引き継いでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. Please pass along this note and tell them I have difficulty speaking and would prefer to communicate in writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the note and your difficulty speaking and preference for written communication to be passed on to the clinical staff. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付から順にお手伝いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will help you step by step, starting with reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道路脇の看板が倒れて、歩く場所にはみ出しています。見た場所を知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 倒れた看板が歩行場所にはみ出す状態を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A sign beside the road has fallen over and is sticking out into the walking area. I would like to report where I saw it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that a fallen sign is protruding into the pedestrian area. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様はいま安全な場所にいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Are you in a safe place now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。道から離れて来ました。誰かがぶつかった場面は見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分は安全で衝突の瞬間は見ていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have moved away from the road. I did not see anyone collide with it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are safe and did not witness the moment of a collision. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 倒れている状態を見たのですね。場所の目印を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So you saw it already lying on the ground. Please tell me a landmark near the location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 公園入口の向かいです。看板の足が歩道側に出ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 公園入口向かいで看板の足が歩道へ出た位置を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is across from the park entrance. The sign's legs were sticking out toward the sidewalk.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the location across from the park entrance where the sign's legs were protruding onto the sidewalk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 人や車の通行に関わる位置ですね。けがをした方を見かけましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: So it is in a position that affects people or vehicles passing by. Did you see anyone injured?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 見かけていません。倒れた理由はわからず、自分では動かしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: けが人未確認で原因不明かつ未移動だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I did not. I do not know why it fell, and I have not moved it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have not seen any injured people, do not know the cause, and have not moved the sign. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見た範囲をそのように記録します。担当が適切な連絡先を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will record only what you saw in that way. The staff member in charge will check the appropriate contact point.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入口の名前と見た時刻を伝えます。事故があったとは言い切りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口名と目撃時刻を知らせ事故発生は断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give you the entrance name and the time I saw it. I will not claim that there was an accident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will provide the entrance name and observation time without stating that an accident definitely occurred. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございます。場所と時刻を担当へ伝えます。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reporting it. I will pass the location and time to the staff member in charge. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この家には同じ名字の兄弟が住んでいます。片方だけに送りたいので、宛名を確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同姓兄弟の住む一住所で弟だけ宛ての荷物の宛名を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two brothers with the same surname live at this house. I only want to send this to one of them, so I would like you to check the addressee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about addressing a parcel to just the younger of two brothers with the same surname at one address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今のラベルには名字だけがあります。お届けしたい方のお名前はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The current label has only the surname. Do you know the name of the person you want it delivered to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、弟の健さんです。住所が同じなので名前を省いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宛先は弟の健で住所が同じため名を省いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, the younger brother, Ken. I left out his given name because the address was the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the recipient is the younger brother Ken and that you omitted his given name because the address was the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ住所でも、届けたい相手の名前を省かず書きましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Even at the same address, please do not omit the name of the person you want it delivered to.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名字と健という名を入れ直します。兄宛ての別の荷物は今日はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 名字と名を記入し今日は兄宛荷物はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will enter both the surname and the given name Ken. I have no separate parcel for the older brother today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the surname and given name and that there is no parcel for the older brother today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、この箱の内容とラベルが弟様向けか確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then please check that this box's contents and label are intended for the younger brother.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 弟に頼まれた本です。箱に付けたメモも弟の名前になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 弟に頼まれた本と弟名のメモが箱に対応すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: These are books the younger brother asked for. The note attached to the box also has his name on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the books requested by the younger brother and the note with his name correspond to this box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できましたね。正式な宛名表記は相手に確認した形で記入してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: You have checked that now. Please use the full, proper addressee name in the form you have confirmed with the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 弟のフルネームを確かめたうえでラベルを書き直し、この一箱を送ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相手の正式フルネームを確認してラベルを直し一箱を送ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm the younger brother's full name, rewrite the label, and send this one box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the recipient's proper full name, correct the label, and send one box. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。記入が終わりましたらお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-04209-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will accept it once you have finished filling it in.
